facts.text: Serve the mains when Ariel sits down to dinner at the castle and finds the fork.
facts.why: Disney Wiki's plot for the 2023 film has no castle dinner or fork scene (that is the 1989 original); Ariel explores the castle and looks through Eric's collection with him.
facts.fix: Serve the mains when Ariel and Eric look through his collection at the castle.

facts.text: Ariel, this human thing goes in the mouth, not the hair. Probably. Pass me a bread roll.
facts.why: Scuttle is the one who gives Ariel wrong information about human things. He never corrects himself about the dinglehopper in the Wikiquote lines, so the note goes against his character.
facts.fix: Ariel, a dinglehopper is for the hair. Trust me. Pass me a bread roll.

fix_note.text: Ariel, a dinglehopper is for the hair. Trust me. Pass me a bread roll.

vibe.verdict: Sweet scuttlebutt tone and a pretty island map, but a tiki bar is a loose fit for the underwater kingdom and the key scenes are missing.
missing: Ursula taking Ariel's voice into the nautilus shell (sea witch's lair)
ideas: Swap 'Ariel's grotto jelly' note for 'Voice in a shell' set in a nautilus mould.
Replace 'Lagoon garlic lime prawns' with 'Flotsam and Jetsam eel' crispy noodles.
Swap 'Plantain chips' for 'Treasure chips' with a plastic fork on the side.
Replace the tiki gong with 'Ring the conch'.
